items.text: Eagles WRs DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both ruled OUT for Monday Night vs Cowboys.
items.implication: Massive target vacuum for remaining Eagles pass catchers; Saquon even more central if active.
items.opportunity: Elevated roles for other Eagles WRs/TEs and checkdowns to Barkley.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle/high ankle sprain) downgraded to OUT vs Bengals; Tyler Huntley starts again.
items.why: High ankle sprain confirmed; missed prior two games, limited practice then ruled out Saturday.
items.implication: Huntley starts; Ravens pass game and dual-threat ceiling drop sharply. Fade Lamar-dependent stacks.
items.opportunity: Increased volume potential for Ravens skill players in easier script if Huntley checks down, but overall offense downgraded.

items.text: Puka Nacua (calf) listed QUESTIONABLE; left Thursday practice early, missed Friday, will test pregame. McVay: felt lack of power/explosion, minor but GTD.
items.why: Calf issue mid-week; limited/no practice Fri. Rapoport/McVay describe as minor but availability up in air.
items.implication: If OUT, Rams WR/TE hierarchy collapses to Higbee lead; huge DFS pivot.
items.opportunity: Tyler Higbee primary beneficiary if out; also Mumpfield/Parkinson/Atwell.

items.text: ETR Sunday injuries OUT: Mike Evans, Deebo Samuel, Davante Adams, Rashee Rice, Jeremiyah Love, David Montgomery, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, Zach Charbonnet, Brian Robinson. IN: Jacobs, Judkins, Addison, Hockenson etc.
items.why: Official/early Sunday designations compiled by ETR.
items.implication: Clear benches; identify handcuffs/beneficiaries (e.g. Judkins IN, Bijan from BRob).
items.opportunity: Role expansion for backups/handcuffs on OUT teams; Judkins/Addison full go.

items.text: Packers activated RB Josh Jacobs from exempt; expected to play Sunday at Detroit.
items.why: Activated off exempt list Saturday; Schefter/Rapoport confirm expected play.
items.implication: Returns after layoff; Berry hates post-layoff workload risk vs Lions.
items.opportunity: Lead back role but snap/carry share uncertain initially.

items.text: Saquon Barkley QUESTIONABLE but expected to play Monday vs Cowboys after hamstring; limited practice return.
items.why: Hamstring from Week 4; practiced, expected active per reports.
items.implication: If active, immediate RB1 restart vs soft Cowboys run D. Berry loves if plays.
items.opportunity: Full workload expected; Dallas elite RB matchup.

items.text: Breece Hall QUESTIONABLE (quad); Berry starts him if active vs Dolphins despite Stephania Bell caution. Crucial DFS/status.
items.why: Returning from injury; limited practice. Levitan flags as slate-crucial.
items.implication: If plays, must-start vs soft MIA; monitor inactives closely.

items.text: Colston Loveland BACK and thriving since Caleb Williams return: 30% target share, 19.2 PPR/game, 6+ rec and 60+ yards both games.
items.why: Sustained high TS and production with Williams under center.
items.implication: Start with confidence as TE1/2; clear every-week play.

items.text: Brian Robinson OUT (hamstring); Bijan Robinson full bellcow + sweet SF DvP (inflates opp RB by 4.4%, recent RB catches/TDs).
items.why: BRob ruled out; 49ers D allowing RB production recently (White, Holani, Harvey, Love).
items.implication: Bijan locked-in every-down RB1 with receiving upside vs inflated DvP.

items.text: With 49ers entire WR corps hurt (Evans/Deebo OUT, others), George Kittle will go nuts + CMC may line up more in slot. Rarely buy RB-as-WR but tempted here amid Kaelon Black/WR injuries.
items.why: Evans/Deebo OUT + other WR injuries create target funnel; CMC smiled at slot question.
items.implication: Kittle elite TE1 ceiling; CMC receiving upside spike.
items.opportunity: Massive routes/targets to Kittle; CMC slot snaps possible.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson played just 21% snaps over last three weeks. Major downgrade signal.
items.why: Sustained low snap share indicates buried on depth chart.
items.implication: Sit/fade; handcuff or stash only if committee changes.
items.opportunity: None currently; monitor for injury ahead.

items.text: Luther Burden only 68.8% routes but elite 2.56 YPRR. Coke Kmet injury may reduce 2/3-TE sets, giving Burden more juice.
items.why: Elite efficiency on limited routes; Kmet absence opens more 11 personnel for Burden.
items.implication: Increased route share and target opportunity for breakout.
items.opportunity: Higher route % and YPRR leverage if sets reduce.

items.text: Berry LOVE: A.J. Brown (usage vs CHI), Tucker Kraft (DET TE D allows TDs), Jaylen Warren, Chuba Hubbard, Bucky Irving (workloads + matchups). Also Saquon if active.
items.why: Matchup juice (CHI/DET soft, RB-friendly Ds) + confirmed workloads/volume.
items.implication: Strong starts; Kraft/TE stream, RBs volume plays.
items.opportunity: High snap/target/carry shares in positive scripts.

items.text: Berry HATE: Rome Odunze (Gonzalez shadow), Josh Downs (low TS/offense), Travis Kelce (tough matchup), Josh Jacobs (layoff workload risk).
items.why: Nasty matchups, role/TS issues, or post-layoff uncertainty.
items.implication: Sit/fade these spots despite name value.
items.conflict: Jacobs now ACTIVE but still hated on volume risk.
